name: DVS Resource Map
description:
This dataset is a directory of 253 social service resource locations, primarily in New York City, with each row representing one organization or service point. It records the resource name, service category (such as employment, homelessness, supportive services, advocacy and assistance, or financial assistance), operating hours, phone number, street address, city, ZIP code, borough, and building details. It also notes whether walk-in visits are accepted, and where available includes an email address, website, and a short description of the specific services offered.

Most entries are in New York City, with Manhattan, Brooklyn, the Bronx, Queens, and Staten Island well represented, and all records list New York State. Contact information is uneven: phone numbers are present for every row, but email addresses are missing for about 85% of entries and building details for about 44%. Hours vary widely, and nearly all locations accept walk-ins.

The data can support searchable resource directories and referral tools for caseworkers and the public
